title: test(app-shell): wait for the counted backfill checkbox in the unchecked publish case (objectui#13120)
body:
Fixes #13120

Clause-②: no

## What changed

Two objectui#12929 test files read the backfill checkbox by its counted name with a synchronous `getByRole`. Both reads now wait with `findByRole`. Each keeps exactly the same name and the same assertion, so a checkbox without the count still fails.

1. **`StudioDesignSurface.publishBackfill-12929.test.tsx`**, case "unchecked: the publish names no field, so nothing is written into existing rows". The read right after `openSheet()` is now `await within(sheet).findByRole('checkbox', { name: new RegExp(...N...) })`: the same `\bN\b` name (N = 12) and the same `not.toBeChecked()`. The other two cases already read it this way. `openSheet()` gets a doc comment saying it resolves once the option is drawn, not once its count is.
2. **`DraftChangesPanel.backfill-12929.test.tsx`**, case "one choice — the added literal-default field of the published object — unchecked, naming the record count". The read after `settled()` and `findAllByTestId('draft-backfill-option')` is now `await screen.findByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Backfill default (12 existing records)' })`, with the exact same string. The claim was amended to add this file in patch round 1.

The PR also adds `.changeset/13120-backfill-checkbox-wait.md` with an empty frontmatter, so it releases nothing; its text names both files. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` asked for it because it counts every file under a released package's `src/` as published source, test files included. No product source changed.

## Why it flaked

In `DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, `EntryDetail` draws the backfill option in the same render that sets `detail` and `candidates`. The record count comes from an effect that runs after that render (`source.find(entry.name, { $top: 0 })`). Until `setRecordCount` lands, the label reads "Backfill default" with no number. Both tests waited for the option, not for its count, so on a slow runner they could read between those two renders. That read finds a checkbox named "Backfill default" and no checkbox whose name contains 12.

## Deterministic reproduction (one-shot, not left in the tree)

For each leg, a script rewrote the file's count-read mock (`ADAPTER.find` in file 1, the `find` set in `beforeEach` in file 2) and checked the rewrite on disk: the anchor count went from 1 to 0 and the injected marker from 0 to 1. After each leg it restored the file from `HEAD` (`git checkout HEAD --` with an absolute path, under an EXIT/INT/TERM trap). The restore was confirmed by comparing blob hashes and by an empty `git diff HEAD`. "+200 ms" means the count resolves 200 ms after it is asked for (`setTimeout`). "Never" means it returns a promise that never settles.

| File | Tree and count read | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 publishBackfill | BASE `ed28057`, unmutated | exit 0, 3 passed: the flake's usual green |
| 1 publishBackfill | BASE, +200 ms | exit 1, 1 failed and 2 passed: the unchecked case, `Unable to find an accessible element with the role "checkbox" and name /\b12\b/` (the same message as merge-group run 39367006901); the role dump shows `Name "Backfill default"` |
| 1 publishBackfill | this branch, +200 ms | exit 0, 3 passed |
| 1 publishBackfill | this branch, never | exit 1, 3 failed: each `Unable to find role="checkbox" and name /\b12\b/` once the `findByRole` window runs out (1164 to 1396 ms) |
| 2 DraftChangesPanel | BASE `ed28057`, unmutated | exit 0, 10 passed |
| 2 DraftChangesPanel | BASE, +200 ms | exit 1, 1 failed and 9 passed: the one-choice case, `Unable to find an accessible element with the role "checkbox" and name "Backfill default (12 existing records)"`; the role dump shows `Name "Backfill default"` |
| 2 DraftChangesPanel | this branch, +200 ms | exit 0, 10 passed |
| 2 DraftChangesPanel | this branch, never | exit 1, 1 failed and 9 passed: the one-choice case, `Unable to find role="checkbox" and name "Backfill default (12 existing records)"` after 1306 ms |

In the "never" legs, every read of the counted name goes red, so none of them was weakened. In file 2, the other nine cases do not read the counted name and stay green.

## Every read in both files

**File 1 (publishBackfill)**
- **Changed:** the unchecked case's counted-checkbox read, which was the file's only synchronous read of the counted name.
- **Left alone:**
  - The checked and stopped-short cases already used `findByRole`.
  - `openSheet()` reads only through waits.
  - `getByTestId('draft-changes-publish')` is the footer button, drawn with the sheet and not count-gated.
  - The request and toast assertions sit behind `waitFor`.

**File 2 (DraftChangesPanel)**
- **Changed:** the one-choice case's counted-checkbox read, the file's only synchronous read of the counted name.
- **Left alone:**
  - In the same case, `options[0]` and its `= false` text come from the option and the literal span, which are drawn with the option, not with the count. The `find` call assertions sit behind `waitFor`.
  - "names no number when the count read carries no numeric total" uses a waiting `findByRole` on the exact name 'Backfill default'. That name is also the pre-count name, so a slow runner can only push it toward green, never red. A one-shot probe showed the case still discriminates: given a numeric total (7), it goes red, `Unable to find role="checkbox" and name "Backfill default"`, 1 failed and 9 passed.
  - The no-package and no-Publish cases make synchronous absence reads after `settled()`. No option is drawn and no count is read, and an absence read cannot turn red because of a slow runner.
  - The footer cases read `/^Backfill default/`, a prefix that matches the label with or without the count. That includes the synchronous `getByRole` after the click in "checked: Publish all passes…". With the count delayed 200 ms, all 10 cases pass on this branch, so these reads were measured as not count-gated. `getByTestId('draft-changes-publish')` is the footer button.
  - The `backfillCandidates` cases are pure function tests.

## Gates

Head `05dc463`. Exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- File 2 unmutated, three runs: exit 0 each, `Tests 10 passed (10)`. File 1 unmutated at this head: exit 0, `Tests 3 passed (3)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` and `lint`: exit 0 each. They ran after `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` (exit 0, 28 of 28 tasks from cache). Lint reports `0 errors`, plus the package's existing warnings, none on either file. `eslint --max-warnings 0` on the two files: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0 (`0 new citation(s)`).
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0 (2 source files, 1 changeset, empty frontmatter).
- These also exit 0: `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`.
- `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on all three paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- The full CI farm runs in CI.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
